facts.value: A B press selects ordinary aerial release and transfers stored charge. An independent L/R press latches cancellation, honored when the current animation frame is zero. There is no early return after release and no else joining these checks, so cancellation processing can still follow a release transition in the same invocation. No grounded common-action guard is present.

facts.value: A successful ftCo_8009917C check suppresses all move-local processing. Otherwise a B press enters ordinary grounded release and consumes persistent charge into local release state. L/R independently latches cancellation; frame zero plus the latch enters Cancel. Release does not return early, so later cancel processing remains possible in that invocation.

facts.value: Passes gobj to the animation-frame query. When startup finishes, passes it to Fighter_ChangeMotionState for ftKb_MS_DkSpecialAirNLoop at frame zero and rate one, then to the local inline which installs death2_cb, take_dmg_cb and effect-hitlag callbacks. The inline performs no collision query or state reconciliation.

facts.value: Advances Kirby's copied Giant Punch aerial startup to the aerial charging loop after animation completion and reinstalls the move's death, damage and effect-hitlag callbacks.

facts.rationale: Corrects xBC from copied-move flag to persistent charge and preserves hitbox gating and both recovery branches.
facts.value: Command variable 0 can advance effect stage x8 from 0 to 1; stage 1 advances to 2 and spawns effect 1194 in air or 1193 otherwise. While hitbox 0 is enabled, lazily caches both hitbox base damages using -1 sentinels and updates both with charge-scaled damage. Animation completion clears persistent charge u.kb.xBC and both hitlag callbacks, then selects Fall for a zero recovery attribute or ftCo_80096900 otherwise. It does not clear the copied ability itself.

facts.rationale: Corrects the persistent charge field's meaning while preserving the two latches and shared hitbox guard.
facts.value: Uses separate one-shot effect and movement latches. Command variable 0 can advance x8 from 0 to 1; stage 1 advances to 2 and spawns a ground/air-specific effect. Enabled hitbox 0 advances x4 from 0 to 1 and gates cached charge-scaled damage updates for both hitboxes. x4==1 advances to 2 and assigns facing-relative charge-scaled ground velocity. Animation completion clears persistent charge u.kb.xBC and hitlag callbacks, then invokes ft_8008A2BC; it does not clear the copied ability itself.
